The '''Imperial Treasury Department''',<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> also referred to simply as the '''Imperial treasury''',<ref name="Flashpoint">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The ''Black Talon''}}</ref> was a governmental organization that oversaw the treasury of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Imperial Treasury Department also oversaw Imperial pay stations such as [[Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973]], which was [[Raid on Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973|raided]] by the criminals [[Risha Drayen]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[Beryl Thorne]] a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before<ref name="The Vault">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|The Vault|Taris}}</ref> [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> However, the heist went poorly; Thorne was captured,<ref name="Beryl's Bargain">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Beryl's Bargain|Taris}}</ref> and the department issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on "Risha Xanthous," an alias for Risha Drayen.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I certainly understand&mdash;as will the Imperial treasury. We need individuals like you if we're to survive the next great war.|[[Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] to [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]] players|<ref name="Flashpoint" />}}
The Imperial Treasury Department was first mentioned with the name "Imperial treasury" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', during the "[[Black Talon]]" Flashpoint, to [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]] players.<ref name="Flashpoint" /> It was later identified by its full name in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2012]] reference guide for ''The Old Republic''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
